candidates.change_summary: Replace `depositsCount++` with `depositsCount += 2` so each deposit increments the counter by two instead of one.
Delete the `depositsCount++` statement so deposits are no longer counted.
Replace the require condition with `false` so every call to receive reverts.
Insert `depositsCount = 0;` before the increment so the counter resets on every deposit.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll so any address can drain the contract's balance.
Withdraw a fixed zero amount instead of the entire contract balance, so no funds are transferred.
Reset depositsCount to zero as part of withdrawAll, changing observable state after the call.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners pass, letting any account other than the owner call withdrawAll.
